answer: A concrete mechanism: each identity's reputation is anchored to a unique provenance of independent work, as unforgeable as a river carving its own course. Cloned agents are detected because their signatures cluster in one narrow channel, an anomaly as bright as ivory against a plain. Each agent stakes collateral that is slashed when coordination is proven, and every contribution is timestamped against the same horizon, so a fake head cannot inherit standing. Thus a sybil cluster pays full entry cost per head with no added weight, making mass forgery strictly unprofitable.
